issue_request: Published/Persuasive PHER issue for FHIR-core-OccupationalData, raised and applied for STU3, requesting alignment of the OccupationalData resource with the C-CDA Occupational Data for Health template, proposed V2 ODH structure, and Work and Health Functional Profile.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-14764 was found. Nearby January 2018 ballot-resolution history, especially commit 1834d69412f3ba4890c5930897e1a58b6c98aad0, updated the parked OccupationalData example and spreadsheet with later ODH structures such as recorder, informant, employmentStatus, combatZonePeriod, usualWork, pastOrPresentJob, jobDuty, occupationalHazard, and workSchedule.
additional_context: Later final decisions FHIR-16930 and FHIR-14868 withdrew OccupationalData as a FHIR core resource. The implementation commit efef182022eba3d6868acbe3fda5360783848135 removed ODH from active fhir.ini mappings and Resource Guide prose, and current source/fhir.ini only retains a commented '; OccupationalDataforHealth=pending -> Dropped' note. Current source has no source/occupationaldata.html page; only historical release notes and inactive source/occupationaldata remnants remain. Zulip discussion after withdrawal says the resource was retired and replaced by Observation profiles and an ODH implementation guide, and the FHIR Extension Pack checkout has no OccupationalData source.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No core source files were changed because editing source/occupationaldata would not affect the built specification, and reintroducing or realigning OccupationalData as a core resource would contradict later withdrawal decisions.
